content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of the LANG environment variable's precedence when setting the locale using LC_ALL. Specifically, when LC_ALL was set, the implementation was giving higher priority to the LANG variable than to other locale categories (like LC_NUMERIC, LC_TIME, etc.), which should have had precedence according to POSIX rules. This led to unexpected behavior when the LANG variable was set, resulting in incorrect locale settings. The patch corrects this by ensuring that if LC_ALL is set, it checks and applies the values of the other LC_* variables, overriding LANG only if those variables are not set.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: break;  /* We already know its variable isn't set */
